title: Hallu-PI: Evaluating Hallucination in Multi-modal Large Language Models within Perturbed Inputs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on the Hallu-PI benchmark to compare hallucination rates (measured via metrics like CHAIR, Cover, Hal, Cog, and PI-Score) before and after applying specific input perturbations, such as image concatenation, image cropping, and prompt misleading.

Designing paired 'Yes' and 'No' prompt query templates for discriminative tasks and calculating an 'Accuracy+' metric (which requires the model to correctly answer both the 'Yes' and 'No' versions of a question) to counteract random guessing and affirmative or negative response biases.
